credits_text: Written & Directed By Dan T. Hall Mall Hall Ran Burns Alex Gorris Ransom Pugh Karl Niemiec Callie Burk Tristan Coe Torry Bantel Alex Raymond Ken Hoyle Shan Sayers Stiles Chris Vonda Vurtman
other_text: A group of amateur ghost hunters go missing as they explore the bowels of an abandoned insane asylum in search of evidence of the 'Lady in White' said to haunt the grounds. Only one evidence film of their last quest is found: 'White' cards discovered by workmen demolishing the dilapidated buildings of the old asylum. Evidence revealed of the Paranormal.
description: Poster features a vintage TV screen showing ghostly figures with flames, titled 'Asylum: The Lost Footage,' with credits and tagline.
